==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{unc|ru}}. Cognate with {{cog|be|гуля́ць}}, {{cog|uk|гуля́ти}} and {{cog|zlw-opl|[[ogół|oguł]]|t=wholeness, entirety}}, for the latter compare {{cog|ru|огу́лом|t=all at once, indiscriminately; together}}. Therefore from {{inh|ru|sla-pro|*gulъ}}.

[[w:Alexander Potebnja|Potebnja]] and Sobolevsky consider earlier meaning "to drink (an alcoholic beverage)", and compare {{cog|uk|гуля́ка|t=drunkard}}, {{cog|sh|гу́лити|t=to [[booze#Verb|booze]], drink heavily}}. It is also proposed to consider "to rest, to spend time resting" the original meaning, and thus connected to {{cog|lt|gulėti|guliù}}, {{m|lt|gulti|t=get into bed, lie down}}. Also connected to {{cog|uk|бити в гулю|t=to play with a ball}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|гуля́ть}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-гулять.ogg}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|гуля́ть|impf|pf=погуля́ть,гульну́ть<q:semelfactive>|vn=гульба́<q:nomen actionis>,гуля́ние<q:nomen actionis>,гуля́нка<q:nomen actionis>,гуля́ка<q:nomen agentis>,гулёна<q:nonen agentis>}}

# to [[walk]], to go for a walk, to [[stroll]]
# to [[have]] [[time-off]], to [[have]] [[free time]]
# to [[make merry]], to [[enjoy oneself]], to [[carouse]]
## to [[party]]
# to [[go with]], to [[go out]] ''with someone''
# {{lb|ru|colloquial}} to [[cheat]], to "stray from" or be unfaithful to one's spouse or partner
#: {{uxi|ru|[[он]] '''гуля́ет'''|He's cheating}}
# {{lb|ru|colloquial|about babies}} to [[stay]] [[awake]]
# to [[let alone]], to stop bothering, [[get lost]]
#: {{ux|ru|Пусть '''гуляет''' отсюда!|Let him get out of here!}}
#: {{ux|ru|Давай '''гуляй''', Вася|Get lost!}}
